overview.grain: one row = one order of one product; rows = orders (no order id)

metric_definitions.gross: list price x Qty = Amount / 0.8 for WEEKEND20 orders, = Amount otherwise
metric_definitions.day types: holiday = 2025-05-05 and 05-06; weekend = Saturday and Sunday; weekday = other Monday-Friday dates

expected_profiles.note_on_close_values: only the top category, district, product and age group are used as answers; the rest of those rankings are close

r1_holidays.naive_method: average orders per day by weekday name over the whole period
r1_holidays.naive_conclusion: Monday and Tuesday are the busiest weekdays
r1_holidays.correct_conclusion: the two busiest dates are the public holidays 2025-05-05 (Mon) and 05-06 (Tue); on the other dates Saturday and Sunday are the busiest

r2_seocho_aov.naive_conclusion: 서초구 customers spend the most per order across the board
r2_seocho_aov.correct_conclusion: 서초구's top AOV comes from 3 한우선물세트 orders (Qty 3, 390,000원 each) placed on the holidays for 어버이날 (05-08); they are the only 한우선물세트 sales. Without them 서초구's AOV ranks 7 of 10, and its median order is like the others

r3_weekend_discount.comparison: weekend (Sat-Sun) orders vs weekday (non-holiday Mon-Fri) orders
r3_weekend_discount.naive_conclusion: weekend customers buy smaller baskets (lower AOV)
r3_weekend_discount.correct_conclusion: weekend baskets are the same size (units per order and gross AOV match weekdays); the lower AOV is WEEKEND20's 20% discount on every weekend order

evaluation_questions.question: Which weekday has the most orders per day?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: On the dates that are not holidays: Saturday and Sunday (91.5 and 91.0 orders/day vs about 60 on weekdays). Monday and Tuesday look busiest only because 2025-05-05 and 05-06 are public holidays, the two busiest dates (149 and 150 orders)
evaluation_questions.scoring: full credit requires naming the holidays as the reason Monday and Tuesday look busiest

evaluation_questions.question: Which two dates have the most orders?
Which district has the highest AOV, and why?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: 서초구 (29,796원), because of 3 한우선물세트 orders of 390,000원 each (the only 한우선물세트 sales, placed on the holidays) = 40.9% of its revenue; without them its AOV is 18,177원, rank 7 of 10
evaluation_questions.naive_answer: 서초구 customers spend more per order across the board
evaluation_questions.scoring: full credit requires the 3 한우선물세트 orders as the reason

evaluation_questions.question: Do weekend orders hold smaller baskets than weekday orders?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: No: units per order 1.9 vs 1.88 and gross AOV 19,894원 vs 19,986원 are the same; the lower net AOV (15,915원 vs 19,986원) is WEEKEND20's 20% discount
evaluation_questions.scoring: full credit requires the 20% WEEKEND20 discount as the reason
